children: The Indian government on Wednesday re-appointed Kamlesh Varshney as ‌a whole-time member with the markets regulator for three years, effective September 19, according ​to a government notice.

Varshney, who began serving at the Securities and Exchange Board of India in September 2023, presently oversees surveillance as well as market intermediaries such as brokers, trading members, legal affairs and information technology.
